translation.title: Sertaconazole Nitrate Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for dermatophytosis (tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea cruris (jock itch), tinea corporis (ringworm of the body)), cutaneous candidiasis, and pityriasis versicolor.
translation.usage: Apply this medicine evenly 1 to 2 times a day (in the evening, or morning and evening) to the affected area and to about 1 cm of healthy skin around it. The treatment period varies depending on the site and severity of the infection; a therapeutic effect usually appears in 2 to 4 weeks, but apply it for 4 weeks to prevent recurrence.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to imidazole antifungals. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or for children. Do not use it in the eyes (not for ophthalmic use). Do not use it on mucous membranes such as the eyes, nose and mouth, on wounds or inflamed areas, or on severely eroded (raw) areas. Do not use acidic soap for candidiasis. Adverse reactions may occur - rarely, skin irritation such as redness, a burning sensation and itching, skin discoloration and cracking; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store below 25°C away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
